notes: Converted from MAME's src/mame/cinematronics/nl_solarq.cpp (NETLIST_START(solarq), CC0-1.0, Aaron Giles) at mame0289 by tools/mame_netlist.py. Every change from MAME's file -- the simulation stand-ins undone, the hacks dropped, the corrections from the sheet -- is logged at the top of boards/solarq-sound.nets.

Compared with the audio board schematic 72-11366 "Solar Quest Audio" rev B, sheets 1-3 (doc 289dbfe65fee pp97-99, native 300 dpi), with the rev A printing (pp90-92) for faint values, and the audio parts list (pp65-67), 2026-10-20: all 50 ICs' types; the inputs from J2 (OUTPUT 0, 1, 4 and 7 on J2-11, -12, -15 and -16, as the CPU board's J4 table on p80 gives them) through the 7414s U1/U2 into the shift registers U3/U4 and the latches U5, U6 and U7; the music divider U8-U10 with its latch gating U19-U23; the clock chain (U24, U25, the divide-by-eleven U26/U15, U27); the nuke generator (U13, U14, the divide-by-191 U11/U12, U15-U18); the noise register U28-U31 with U18, U24 and U32; every channel -- loud and soft explosion, thrust, capture (Q11-Q13, U42 566, U21), photon (U35, Q7-Q10, U36-U41), fire (Q14/Q15, U43-U47) and the three music envelopes (Q16-Q21) into U48 -- and the CS follower U49 and summing amplifier U50 all agree with MAME pin for pin and value for value (R1-R164, C1-C31), transistor and diode orientation included. The parts list agrees with every IC, resistor, capacitor, diode and transistor quantity, except R155 in the final amplifier. Corrected from the sheet, none of it in a sound path: Y1 is a 20 MHz crystal, not an ideal clock, and U44 and U46 are CA3080As (the parts list's 'special' grade, same pinout), not plain CA3080s. The two printings differ only in labels.

Drafting slips where MAME follows the part, not the label: U10's pins 9 and 7 are labelled ENP and LOAD inside the box (the signals on them, MLOAD- and MEN+, are right); rev B's sheet 2 prints U18 as "-S86" (LS86 on rev A, on sheet 1 and in the parts list). MAME grounds U2 pins 8 and 10, which are 7414 outputs, and leaves the inputs 9 and 11 open -- the sheet's note 6 says all four are unused, and this file has all four nc. Not in this file: the final amplifier (U51, Q22, Q23, R152-R160, C32-C36, D9, D10), the regulators U52/U53 with D1-D4 and C37-C43, and the unnumbered decoupling capacitors.
conflicts: The theory text's sound check table (p33) puts Capture on U7 pin 9 and Fire on pin 12; both printings of the sheet, and MAME, have FIRE- on 9 and CAPTURE- on 12. This file follows the sheet.
R155 in the final amplifier is printed 150K; the parts list has no 150K and two 150-ohm resistors. Not in this file.
